reason: New test-only function; it adds coverage without deleting or weakening any existing assertion.
headline: New test checks compactor Write propagates FromSelectedSeries hint
summary: Adds a test that produces a selected-series block via CompactSelectedSeries, rewrites it through compactor.Write with the source meta as base, and asserts the new block keeps the FromSelectedSeries hint. It exercises the new propagation branch in LeveledCompactor.Write and cannot affect production behavior, so a line-by-line review is unnecessary.
